newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Five people killed in Philippines robbery.
newsitem.headline: Five people killed in Philippines robbery.

text.p: A Filipino-Chinese couple were among five people stabbed to death in their Manila home on Saturday by thieves who made off with cash and jewellery, police said.
The victims died of multiple stab wounds, police officer Pedro Angulo told reporters. Four of them had been tied up.
Besides the Chinese couple, the victims include two security guards and a maid.
A 70-year-old woman who managed to escape the massacre told police two knife-wielding men had barged into the house early on Saturday and stripped the occupants of cash and jewellery.
The massacre came on the heels of a spate of kidnappings-for-ransom targeting rich Filipino-Chinese businessmen in the city in the past several months.
